scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @triggertracker/api" "npm run dev -w @triggertracker/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @triggertracker/web && npm run build -w @triggertracker/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p apps/api && npm run typecheck -w @triggertracker/web
